audio.text: When is the deadline for the physics lab report?

options: In the lab on the third floor.
I already reported it to the instructor.
It's due next Thursday by noon.
Yes, the physics lab is really hard.

why.en: "When" → a time. A answers "where"; B repeats "report" with a different meaning; D answers a yes/no question nobody asked.
why.tr: "When" → zaman. A "nerede" sorusunu cevaplıyor; B "report" kelimesini başka anlamda tekrar ediyor; D sorulmamış bir evet/hayır sorusuna cevap veriyor.
why.es: "When" → un momento. A responde a "where"; B repite "report" con otro significado; D responde a una pregunta de sí/no que nadie hizo.
